g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W. Pin 1 is nearest the microSD slot, inner row (square pad on the underside). Pin 1 also feeds U2; see wiring-audio. R1-R4 sit inline in BUTTON1-4 within 50 mm of J8.

g.title: BTN
g.text: Four IP67 anti-vandal contacts with gold contacts. Return terminals are daisy-chained at the faceplate; one return wire goes back to J8 pin 20. Populate positions 1-n.

g.title: U3
g.text: Retained module; E4 open. VCC 3.3 V. IN LOW energizes the coil; GPIO5 and GPIO6 are driven high from boot. Coil supply and contacts are in wiring-power.

g.title: U6
g.text: Adafruit 4885, I2C address 0x44, beside the camera window. 3V pad is the breakout regulator output and stays unconnected.

g.title: HSW1
g.text: Bought logic-level low-side switch module with gate pull-down. SIG high turns the heater on. Power and load terminals are in wiring-power.
